fields.flowNotes:
Six screens on A4 in pen, numbered at the top of each sheet. Checkpoint 1 job: a dropper's Sunday mock mistakes come back to him on their own instead of into a notebook he never opens.

1. Import the test. Two buttons, 'Upload the PDF report' and 'Enter mistakes by hand'. Upload opens the file picker, then goes to 2.
2. Check the mistakes. The questions read out of the PDF, each with the subject and chapter it guessed and a tick box. He unticks the wrong guesses, taps 'Looks right', goes to 3.
3. Your revision plan. A two-week calendar strip with Wednesday, Saturday and the Thursday after circled, and 'You will get 40 questions in three sets'. 'Turn on reminders' lands on 4.
4. Today's set. The screen that carries the product: one question at a time, four options, a timer counting up, a Skip. Answering shows right or wrong and the one-line reason, then the next. At fifteen minutes it shows how many he got right this time against the test.
5. Empty state, on a day with nothing due: 'Nothing due today. Next set on Saturday', with 'Import another test' going to 1.
6. Could not read the PDF. The file name, then 'Try another file' back to 1 or 'Enter by hand' to the manual version of 2.

Screen 4 carries it because revising should take fifteen minutes, not three hours of copying.

- drawn and written up by Ishaan Kulkarni, ishaan.kulkarni@example.com
